caption.run: One card per step. Lanes = state in the latest run: run {run}.
caption.runPinned: One card per step. Lanes = state in the latest run: run {run} (revision {rev}).
caption.noRun: One card per step. No run yet, so every step is in Not run yet.
caption.runFailed: Could not load the latest run, so its states are not shown.
caption.plan: One card per step. Draft = new or changed vs the active revision; Ready = unchanged; Checkpoint = waits for a person.
caption.planNoActive: One card per step. Nothing is active yet, so every step is a Draft unless it waits for a person.
caption.graph: Graph from each step's dependencies; a dashed border is a checkpoint. Colours show the latest run.
caption.graphList: Steps in order, with what each waits on.

graph.aria: Plan steps as a dependency graph

edit.title: Step {n}
edit.checkpointLabel: Checkpoint: wait for a person before going on
edit.hint: Saving proposes revision {next}, based on revision {rev}. Other proposals stay as they are; it applies from the next run once it is made active.
edit.archived: This project is archived, so its plan can't change.
edit.viewOnly: You can view this step. Only project members can change it.

noSteps: This revision has no steps yet.

since.textOnly: No step changed since v{base}; only the playbook text did.
since.same: Same steps and text as v{base}.
